title.en: Matrices, linear maps, and linear systems
title.zh: 矩阵、线性映射与线性方程组

lead.en: Read a matrix as a map, compose in the correct order, preserve solution sets during elimination, classify systems, and implement a batched affine layer with explicit dimensions.
lead.zh: 把矩阵读作映射，正确顺序复合，消元保持解集，分类系统，并按明确维度实现批仿射层。

prerequisites.en: Module 09: coordinate vectors, dot products, points versus displacements, NumPy shapes and broadcasting. Optional algorithm cost comparisons refer to Module 06.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 09：坐标向量、点积、点与位移、NumPy 形状与广播。可选算法成本比较参考模块 06。

en: Explain matrix columns as images of coordinate unit vectors.
Multiply compatible matrices and justify composition/transpose order.
Prove elementary augmented-row operations preserve a system's solutions.
Use pivots and contradiction rows to classify unique, inconsistent, and underdetermined systems.
Explain invertibility, determinant interpretation, and limits of a small residual.
Annotate every shape in column-vector and batched-row affine maps.
zh: 解释矩阵列为坐标单位向量像。
乘相容矩阵并说明复合、转置顺序。
证明增广行初等操作保持解集。
按主元与矛盾行判唯一、无解、欠定。
解释可逆、行列式含义与小残差限制。
标列向量及批行仿射映射全部形状。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2; follow column images and composition order.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节，跟踪列像与复合顺序。

text.en: Implement products; preview the batched shape contract from Section 6.
text.zh: 实现乘积，预看第 6 节的批形状约定。

text.en: Explain why the rightmost column-vector map acts first.
text.zh: 解释列向量最右映射先执行。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and trace a pivoted augmented system.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节并跟踪带主元交换的增广系统。

text.en: Distinguish a free variable from a contradiction row.
text.zh: 区分自由变量与矛盾行。

text.en: Read Section 5 and explore transformed grids.
text.zh: 阅读第 5 节并探索变换网格。

text.en: Run exact Fraction elimination and verify each system class.
text.zh: 运行 Fraction 精确消元，核对各系统类别。

title.zh: 批形状、求解器与敏感性

text.en: Read Section 6; reconcile row and column conventions.
text.zh: 阅读第 6 节，协调行与列约定。

text.en: Compare solves and diagnose singularity and sensitive data.
text.zh: 比较求解，诊断奇异与敏感数据。

text.en: Complete choices and the written system classification.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面系统分类。

text.en: Check NumPy solve's nonsingular square-matrix contract.
text.zh: 查 NumPy solve 的非奇异方阵约定。

text.en: Complete the exit task and rank/null-space readiness check.
text.zh: 完成结业任务与秩、零空间准备检查。
